reviews.stars: {rating, plural, one {# star out of 5} other {# stars out of 5}}

reviews.rejectedNote: This review was not published. It may break the review guidelines.
reviews.flash: Thank you. Your review was sent and is waiting for moderation.

empty.title: No visits to review
empty.body: After a visit is completed, you can review it here.

reviews.noneDue: No completed visits are waiting for a review.

state.denied: You do not have access to these reviews.
state.gated: Reviews are not connected yet. Nothing here is saved.

form.title: Review your visit
form.intro: Describe the service: punctuality, care and communication. Do not include health details, phone numbers, emails or links.

errors.rating_required: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
errors.text_contact: Remove phone numbers, emails and links from your review.

form.conflict: This review changed in another window. Go back to your reviews to see the latest version.

reviews.editNote: Editing sends the review back for moderation. It is hidden until it is checked again.
reviews.withdrawnNote: You withdrew this review. It is not shown to anyone.

rejectedReason.personal_info: It included personal or health details.
rejectedReason.not_about_service: It was not about the service received.
rejectedReason.spam: It looked like advertising or spam.

reviews.flashEdited: Your changes were sent and are waiting for moderation.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this review?
withdraw.body: It will be hidden for good, and you will not be able to review this visit again.

reminders.title: Reminder preferences
reminders.description: Choose how we remind you about upcoming visits. Booking status always shows in your account, whatever you choose here.
reminders.channelsHint: Turn on any you want. With all off, you will only see reminders when you sign in.

channelHints.sms: To the mobile number on your account.
channelHints.whatsapp: Only if you use WhatsApp on that number.
channelHints.email: To the email on your account, if you added one.

reminders.allOff: All channels are off. You will not get visit reminders outside your account.
reminders.quietToggle: Do not send reminders during quiet hours
reminders.quietHint: Times are India time (IST). Quiet hours can run past midnight, for example 21:00 to 07:00.
reminders.quietOvernight: This runs overnight into the next morning.
reminders.conflict: These preferences changed in another window. Reload the page to see the latest, then try again.

errors.quiet_start_invalid: Enter a start time, for example 21:00.
errors.quiet_end_invalid: Enter an end time, for example 07:00.
errors.quiet_same: Start and end cannot be the same time.

state.denied: You do not have access to these preferences.
state.gated: Reminder preferences are not connected yet. Nothing here is saved.
